Topic at a Glance
Article 341 of the Constitution of India is titled “Scheduled Castes”. It forms an integral component of Special Provisions relating to Certain Classes (Articles 330–342A), located within the “Special Classes” cluster. Current through the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023.
